description:
Base champion: Lillia

Skin:  Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: Darkrai from the Pokemon franchise

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Silent voiceover.

-Spiritomb included.

-Nightmares included.

-Happy Halloween 2024!

legacy Changelog:

-25/02/2025: Fixed for new patch (Credits of this fix to AleXD)

Sources and references:

-All animations made by me

-Rig and model extracted from Pokemon, then adapted.

-Sound effects; some made by me, others adapted from Pokemon assets, others made by ksound kaiju (contacting the original author was not possible).

-Voice in taunt emote from Dumbs.

-The songs in Dance emote are, in order:

---Pokemon intro (original)

---Battle vs Dialga, Pokemon Mistery Dungeon explorers of time

---Advanced battle theme from Pokemon Ruby/Shaphire (original versions)

---Battle VS Red, metal version by unknown annonymous artist.

---Lavender town music

-The easter egg when summoning the Herald is a meme related to the spanish youtuber/streamer Knekro.

-The screen effect in the joke emote was first engineered by other memebers of the community, between them NyhtSeven.

-Splashart and ability icons built from Pokemon cards art.
